sources.summary: **The first comprehensive monograph on multidisciplinary design studio Formafantasma, one of the most creative and innovative design duos working today** Formafantasma is a research-driven design studio founded in 2009 by Andrea Trimarchi and Simone Farresin. This monograph, edited by Alessandro Rabottini, offers a comprehensive, critical examination of their pioneering practice. Over the past decade, Formafantasma has emerged as one of the most influential studios of its generation.
